answer: Each identity must anchor itself to a stake that ripens over time: a newcomer plants a bond in the shared orchard and earns harvest rights only after twenty epochs of useful work, with each epoch's yield tied to verified output. At dawn each day a random audit samples a slice of the orchard; identities with copied work or idle plots forfeit their bond to the auditors. Spinning up 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 bonds plus twenty epochs of waiting, while one honest agent pays once and harvests forever: sybils pay per identity, honest agents pay once.
